name: EVAPCO eco-Air EAW-DD 1512XL017G7 double-stack dry/adiabatic cooler
description: Double-stack closed-circuit dry cooler with optional adiabatic pad or spray pre-cooling; 12 EC fans, three 14.9 ft modules, stainless coil tubing. Marketed for data centers.

capacity_w.note: nominal 8330 MBH DRY at 110->100 F fluid (43.3->37.8 C) with 92 F (33.3 C) entering air dry bulb; 8330 * 293.07 W/MBH = 2.441 MW. Adiabatic mode raises capacity at high ambient (site-dependent)

approach_k.note: leaving fluid 100 F minus entering air 92 F = 8 F = 4.4 K at the nominal rating

power_w.note: total EC fan motor rating 278 HP (207 kW) for 12 fans; nameplate, actual absorbed power at rating not published

footprint_w_mm.note: 11 ft 10.5 in; 13 ft 6 in (4115 mm) with adiabatic pads
